LanguageData.RL_CargoAccessDesc: Allow pawns to load and retrieve goods at this station.
LanguageData.RL_CargoCallDesc: Choose a pawn to operate this station and wait for the basket.
LanguageData.RL_CargoDisconnected: Shaft not connected: this station is not attached to a hoist body, or it sits outside the floors that hoist serves. Build the hoist body in the same shaft first, then a station on each floor that should stop here.
LanguageData.RL_CargoNeedsFloor: Both floors must already exist and have supported surfaces.
LanguageData.RL_CargoNeedsShaft: Build next to exactly one existing shaft, vertically aligned.
LanguageData.RL_CargoTwoMasters: Two hoist motors cannot share a shaft.
LanguageData.RL_CargoUnloadFirst: Unload the basket before dismantling its motor.
LanguageData.RL_CargoEmpty: Empty. Pawns fill the basket through hauling work.
LanguageData.RL_CargoNoDestination: No suitable storage destination. Set another storage area to accept this item.
